newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES WEAKER AT 234-235 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES WEAKER AT 234-235 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The lev fell to 234-235 per dollar at the close from around 230 in the morning and some 12 levs down from Wednesday's close as foreign currency demand strongly topped supply on the interbank market, dealers said.

"Final clients were bidding for large dollar volumes all day long, which combined with the longer period to value date of spot deals to push the lev sharply down to 234-235 at the end of trade," one dealer said.
The lev closed at 222-223 on Wednesday.
According to some traders one of the final clients probably was a large fuel importer.
The central bank sold dollars at market rates but the volumes it offered covered just a small part of the demand, dealers said.

Foreign currency supply by commercial banks was very low due to their reluctance to shorten forex positions amid an ongoing decline of the lev, traders said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
